name: Halftone dots — effect fixture
description: Proving fixture for the halftone-dots Effect (ported to WGSL from @paper-design/shaders halftone-dots, Apache-2.0). Classic square-grid dot screen over the pullquote-on-photo surface: the substrate's tonal ramps size the ink dots (dark → big, bright → paper shows through), so the moody photo becomes a printed halftone and the bright quote knocks out to paper — the print convention. Palette mode: near-black ink on warm paper. Full-frame piece (backgroundFill); the effect's transparent-alpha contract (E4) is masked to the content silhouette by construction. Fixture — exercises the pipeline, not held to the deliverable floors.

content.title: Dark cells swell into ink; bright cells shrink to pinpoints — the picture lives in the size of the dots.
content.author: HALFTONE — CLASSIC · SQUARE GRID
